title: Hazy Dutch Kaffir Stamppot
description: A bitter and fluffy Dutch dish featuring kaffir-lime-leaf, perfect for festive occasions and gluten-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 20015C (40015F) and toast the kaffir lime leaves in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until wilted.
Mash the potatoes in a bowl until they are fluffy, then mix in the toasted kaffir lime leaves, a pinch of salt, and a few grinds of black pepper.
Transfer the potato mixture to a tandoor or a preheated oven-safe dish and cook at 20015C (40015F) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown on top.
Serve hot, garnished with additional kaffir lime leaves if desired.
